message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/file && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"fuzz/magic_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":68,"var":"data,size","code":"magic_buffer(magic, data, size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes from the fuzz input are passed directly into libmagic for analysis."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/magic.c","function":"magic_buffer","line":559,"var":"buf,nb","code":"file_buffer(ms, -1, NULL, NULL, buf, nb)","note":"The raw input buffer is wrapped as a file buffer and handed to the file-type detection pipeline."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/ascmagic.c","function":"file_ascmagic","line":92,"var":"bb","code":"file_encoding(ms, &bb, &ubuf, &ulen, &code, &code_mime, &type)","note":"Text/encoding detection converts the attacker bytes into a Unicode buffer when the data looks like text."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/encoding.c","function":"file_encoding","line":119,"var":"buf,nbytes,ubuf,ulen","code":"else if (file_looks_utf8(buf, nbytes, *ubuf, ulen) > 1)","note":"A UTF-8-looking payload causes the code to populate ubuf with decoded code points and report text encoding."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/encoding.c","function":"file_looks_utf8","line":350,"var":"buf[i]","code":"for (i = 0; i < nbytes; i++) { ... if ((buf[i] & 0x80) == 0) ... else { ... for (n = 0; n < following; n++) { i++; if (i >= nbytes) goto done; ... } }","note":"The decoder walks attacker-controlled multibyte sequences and may stop exactly at the end of the supplied buffer while building ubuf."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/ascmagic.c","function":"file_ascmagic_with_encoding","line":156,"var":"utf8_buf,bb","code":"rv = file_softmagic(ms, &bb, NULL, NULL, TEXTTEST, text)","note":"The converted text buffer is re-scanned by softmagic, propagating the attacker-controlled content into rule matching."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/softmagic.c","function":"file_softmagic","line":117,"var":"b","code":"for (ml = ms->mlist[0]->next; ml != ms->mlist[0]; ml = ml->next) if ((rv = match(..., b, ...)) != 0) return rv;","note":"Softmagic iterates over compiled magic rules and dispatches the converted buffer into pattern matchers."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/softmagic.c","function":"match","line":null,"var":"bb.fbuf,bb.flen","code":"mget(ms, m, b, CAST(const unsigned char *, bb.fbuf), bb.flen, ...)","note":"Rule evaluation reads from the attacker-derived buffer contents using offsets and lengths computed from the input."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src/softmagic.c","function":"mget","line":null,"var":"pattern/data access","code":"Magic rule handlers dereference bytes from the supplied buffer to compare strings, numbers, and continuations.","note":"This is the memory-safety sink: a malformed rule/input combination can drive an out-of-bounds read in the matcher path."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
